'''Sawyn Maculhene''' was a general during the rise of [[Artur Hawkwing]] who followed the [[False Dragon]] [[Guaire Amalasan]].

== History ==
He was a clever cavalry leader.

In {{fy|943}}, after Amalasan was captured, he sent out from [[Khodomar]] with a five thousand-strong army. Together with [[Elinde Motheneos]], he captured at least two of the [[Alindrelle Erinin]] bridges and attacked the [[White Tower]]. He was killed during their defeat.{{ref/book|bwb|11}}
